ATR: Average True Range as a percentage of price -- how much this stock typically moves in a single day. A higher ATR% means bigger day-to-day swings are normal for it.
DIST_SMA200: How far the current price sits above or below its 200-day moving average, a common gauge of the stock's longer-term trend.
52W_RANGE: Where the current price sits within its 52-week high-low range, as a percentage -- 100% would be the 52-week high, 0% the 52-week low.
RSI: Relative Strength Index (0-100), a momentum gauge. Above 70 is typically considered overbought, below 30 oversold.
RVOL: Relative Volume -- today's trading volume compared to its typical level. 1.0x is average; higher means unusually heavy trading.
RESISTANCE: A price level where the stock has previously struggled to rise above -- often where sellers step back in.
SUPPORT: A price level where the stock has previously found buying interest -- often where a decline tends to slow or reverse.
FAIR_VALUE_ANCHOR: A model-estimated fair price for the stock, used as a reference point for whether the current price looks stretched.
VALUE_AREA: The price range where most recent trading volume has occurred -- the zone the market has spent the most time agreeing on as fair value.
CONF: Confidence (0-100) in the current technical setup classification, based on how many signals agree with it.
BIAS: Net directional bias (-100 to +100) implied by the technical setup -- positive leans bullish, negative leans bearish.
TRAILING_PE: Price-to-Earnings ratio using the last 12 months of actual earnings -- how much investors are paying per dollar of past profit.
FORWARD_PE: Price-to-Earnings ratio using analysts' estimated earnings for the next 12 months.
PE_VS_5Y_MED: How today's trailing P/E compares to this stock's own 5-year median P/E -- negative means it's cheaper than its own history.
EV_EBITDA: Enterprise Value divided by EBITDA -- a valuation multiple that, unlike P/E, accounts for debt and isn't affected by financing structure.
PEG: P/E ratio divided by expected earnings growth rate -- a lower PEG can indicate a stock is cheap relative to its growth.
ROIC: Return on Invested Capital -- how efficiently the company turns invested capital into profit.
ROE: Return on Equity -- how much profit the company generates per dollar of shareholder equity.
GROSS_MARGIN: Revenue remaining after the direct cost of producing goods or services, as a percentage of revenue.
OP_MARGIN: Operating Margin -- profit remaining after operating expenses, as a percentage of revenue.
FCF_YIELD: Free Cash Flow Yield -- annual free cash flow as a percentage of the company's market value, a cash-based alternative to earnings yield.
REVENUE_YOY: Revenue growth compared to the same period one year ago.
EPS_YOY: Earnings-per-share growth compared to the same period one year ago.
10Y_YIELD: The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield -- the risk-free rate used as a benchmark for valuing riskier assets like stocks.
EXCESS_EY: How much this stock's earnings yield exceeds the 10-year Treasury yield -- the extra compensation for taking on equity risk over a risk-free bond.
EXCESS_21D: This stock's return over the last 21 trading days, minus its benchmark's return over the same period.
RATE_SENS: How sensitive this stock's returns have historically been to moves in the 10-year Treasury yield.
MACD_SIGNAL: Moving Average Convergence Divergence -- a trend-following momentum indicator. Bullish means the MACD line has crossed above its signal line; bearish means it's crossed below.
MACD_HISTOGRAM: The gap between the MACD line and its signal line -- a widening histogram means the current trend is strengthening, a narrowing one means it's losing steam.
MACD_BARS: How many trading sessions have passed since MACD last crossed its signal line -- a fresher cross carries more weight than an old one.
DIST_SMA20: How far the current price sits above or below its 20-day moving average, a gauge of short-term trend.
DIST_SMA50: How far the current price sits above or below its 50-day moving average, a gauge of medium-term trend.
52W_HIGH: The highest price this stock has traded at over the last 52 weeks.
52W_LOW: The lowest price this stock has traded at over the last 52 weeks.
UP_DOWN_VOLUME: The ratio of volume on up days to volume on down days -- above 1.0 means buyers have been moving more shares than sellers recently.
VOL_PERCENTILE: Where this stock's current price volatility ranks against its own past year -- 99% means swings are wider than 99% of days over that period.
RETURN_WINDOW: This stock's price return over the stated window, ending today.
MARKET_CAP: Total market value of all outstanding shares -- share price multiplied by shares outstanding.
BETA: How much this stock has historically moved relative to the broader market -- above 1.0 means more volatile than the market, below 1.0 means less.
DEBT_TO_EQUITY: Total debt divided by shareholder equity -- a higher ratio means the company relies more on borrowed money relative to its own capital.
CURRENT_RATIO: Current assets divided by current liabilities -- a gauge of whether the company can cover its near-term obligations. Above 1.0 generally means it can.
PRICE_TO_BOOK: Share price divided by book value per share -- how much investors are paying relative to the company's net accounting assets.
PRICE_TO_SALES: Share price divided by revenue per share -- a valuation multiple useful when earnings are volatile or negative.
EV_REVENUE: Enterprise Value divided by revenue -- a valuation multiple that, like EV/EBITDA, accounts for debt and cash on the balance sheet.
DIVIDEND_YIELD: Annual dividend payments as a percentage of share price. Only shown for stocks that actually pay a dividend.
